explanation.text: A computer has different parts that work together. The monitor shows pictures and words, the keyboard lets us type, and the mouse lets us point and click.
explanation.example: When you type your name, you use the keyboard. When you see it appear, you are looking at the monitor.

questions.prompt: Which part of the computer shows pictures and words on the screen?

hints.small: This part looks like a TV screen.
hints.big: It's the screen we look at, not something we type or click with.

explanationSteps: The monitor is the screen that displays pictures and words.
We look at the monitor to see what the computer is showing us.

questions.prompt: Which part of the computer is the main box that does the 'thinking'?

hints.small: Think about what a brain does for our body.
hints.big: The CPU processes information, just like a brain processes thoughts.

explanationSteps: The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is often called the computer's brain.
It processes all the information and instructions.

questions.prompt: What do we call the outer case that holds the computer's main parts together?

hints.small: It's like a protective box for the important parts inside.
hints.big: The cabinet (or case) houses the CPU and other main parts.

explanationSteps: The cabinet is the outer case that holds and protects the computer's main parts.
It keeps the CPU and other components safe inside.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an example of computer hardware (a part you can touch)?

hints.small: Hardware means parts you can physically touch.
hints.big: A keyboard is a real, touchable object, unlike a song or a password.

explanationSteps: Hardware means the physical parts of a computer that you can touch.
A keyboard is hardware because it is a real object.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an example of software (something you cannot touch)?

hints.small: Software is a program, not a physical object.
hints.big: A drawing app is a program that runs on the computer — you can't touch it.

explanationSteps: Software means programs and instructions, not physical parts.
A drawing app is software because it's a program, not something you can touch.

questions.prompt: What do we call the wires used to connect computer parts together?

hints.small: Think about what connects the keyboard or mouse to the computer.
hints.big: Cables carry information and power between different parts.

explanationSteps: Cables are wires that connect computer parts together.
They help devices like the keyboard or monitor talk to the computer.

questions.prompt: What do we call a small, portable computer that opens like a book?

hints.small: You can carry this computer around and it folds shut.
hints.big: A laptop has its screen and keyboard built into one folding case.

explanationSteps: A laptop is a portable computer that folds like a book.
It has the screen, keyboard, and CPU all built into one case.

questions.prompt: Which part of the computer stores files so you can open them later, even after turning the computer off?

hints.small: Think about where your saved files live when the computer is off.
hints.big: Storage keeps files saved even without power, unlike some other memory.

explanationSteps: Storage (like a hard disk) keeps files saved even when the computer is turned off.
This is different from the monitor or speaker, which don't store files.
